sentences.en: She has been promoted twice since she joined this company.
sentences.zh: 自从加入这家公司以来，她已经晋升了两次。

sentences.en: Dad said he'd be promoted to section manager next year.
sentences.zh: 爸爸说他明年会被提升为部门经理。

sentences.en: His lack of technical knowledge kept him from being promoted.
sentences.zh: 由于缺乏技术知识，他没有被晋升。

senses.zh: 成为王后或其他大于卒的子
